items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Mr. Anderson tells me the man that lived next door to me was a white gentleman that lived in the neighborhood and he said the poker games on Saturday with Babe Ruth, and Fats Waller, and Earl Stanley, they was just marvelous.

ctx.x: This neighborhood is like… it was [unintelligible] maybe 60 years ago but a sportsman. Earl Stanley lived out here, a great jockey. Babe Ruth‟s house is around the corner, the only house that has tall columns on it.
